Subject: Private deployment pricing — breakdown for CFO

Hi Dylan / Lauren,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement and finance asked me for a clear cost split so their FP&A model can account for it. Specifically they want:

- A line‑item breakdown between the Professional Services SOW (onboarding + migration) and the recurring Platform Fee for a VPC/private deployment.
- Amortization examples over 12/24/36 months so we can show OPEX vs CapEx for the board deck.
- Any available multi‑year discounts or credits tied to committed spend; we are evaluating a 24‑month reserved capacity commitment.

I've attached our RFP requirements — procurement asked for this by EOD Monday. Can you also confirm support tiers and whether support hours are included in the platform fee or billed separately?

Thanks,
Emily

Acme Corporation

Hi Emily — thanks, this is straightforward to lay out. High level options we typically present (estimates here):

Option A — Standard setup + annual platform fee:
- One‑time SOW (migration + 4 weeks onboarding): $120k
- Recurring platform fee (dedicated VPC, baseline capacity): $32k/month
- Support: Standard included (business hours); Premium add‑on +$6k/month

Option B — Committed 24‑month reserved capacity (lowest unit cost):
- One‑time SOW: $108k (10% off)
- Platform fee: $26k/month (18% off list with 24‑month commit)
- Support: Premium included for first 6 months; then optional add‑on

Option C — SOW capitalized into multi‑year contract (amortized):
- Capitalized SOW spread over 24 months -> $4.5k/month extra to platform fee (example)
- Platform fee discounts deeper for larger committed spend brackets

I'll attach a pricing matrix with line items and simple amortization examples. Avery, can you drop a quick SOW estimate (hours & rates) for the migration work so Emily has the full line items for finance?

Next steps: I'll send a formal proposal and a sample amortization table by Monday. If procurement has a target discount (e.g., 20–25%), please call that out so we can route approvals earlier.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Emily / Dylan — quick SOW estimate and assumptions below (high level):

Assumptions:
- 4 weeks of on‑site/remote runbook migration + 2 weeks integration testing
- 1 day of training per team (DevOps + App owners)
- Standard connectors only (no custom model conversion)

SOW estimate (time & rates):
- Solutions architect: 60 hours @ $250/hr = $15,000
- Infra engineer: 120 hours @ $200/hr = $24,000
- Integration eng: 80 hours @ $180/hr = $14,400
- Project management & testing: 40 hours @ $150/hr = $6,000
- Contingency (10%): $5,540

Estimated total SOW: $64,940 (~$65k)

We typically offer a 10% SOW discount when platform fee is committed for >=24 months. Another pathway is to apply a one‑time onboarding credit that reduces the first 3 months of the platform fee instead of discounting the SOW line. Let me know which the finance team prefers.

Attachment: SOW_estimate_Acme_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Regards,
Avery Johnson
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

1) Our preference is to capitalize the SOW across 24 months for the board; can you provide an amortization example that rolls the SOW into the monthly platform charge with an explicit line item?
2) Payment terms: will Redwood accept Net 60 for enterprise procurement?
3) Discount request: given the scale and a committed 24‑month reservation, the CFO is asking for a 25% reduction to the platform fee (off list). Is that in scope? If not, please propose your best counter.

Acme Procurement

Hi — quick answers and a proposed commercial handrail: 

1) Amortization example: If SOW = $65k and you spread over 24 months, that adds ~$2,708/month. We can include that as a separate "SOW amortization" line on the invoice or roll it into the platform fee. I'll include both formats in the revised proposal (attached).

2) Payment terms: standard offering is Net 30. We can accept Net 60 for enterprise contracts with a mid‑tier finance review; Net 60 will require a small financing fee unless the contract reaches an agreed ARR threshold. I'll propose Net 60 with a 1.5% fee applied to annual billed amount — open to negotiation.

3) Discounting: 25% off list on platform fee is outside our standard discount band for 24‑month commitments. Internal approval path is needed for anything >20%. That said, we can do the following: 
- 18% off the platform fee for a 24‑month committed reserved capacity (this includes the first month free).
- 10% off SOW (reduces the $65k to ~$58.5k), or instead offer a one‑time onboarding credit equal to 3 months of platform fee.
- Offer Premium support included for the first 6 months (normally an add‑on).

I've attached Proposal_v2 with line items and both amortization views. If Acme's CFO needs to hit 25% total cost reduction, we can explore a blended credit (platform fee + upfront credit + extended commit) but that requires escalated approval from my manager.

Proposal: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Proposal_v2 (proposal_v2.pdf)
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/Member/PowerFormSigning?PowerFormId=0a1b2c3d4e5f

Let me know if you want me to loop finance/legal in. If this commercial handrail looks acceptable I can start a redline with legal and route for signature.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
